The main takeaway from our work is that
implicit solvent models are a good approximation to the solvation free energies of proteins and ligands, and they are useful for modeling protein–ligand interactions.

the Surface Generalized-Born model can be used to estimate the binding affinities of protein–ligand interactions with a good level of accuracy and a speedup of over 1000-fold over explicit solvent FEP.
